subject: math
description: Compare and apply the special properties of rectangles, squares, and rhombuses, including side, angle, and diagonal relationships.
learningObjectives: Classify rectangles, squares, and rhombuses using definitions and always-true properties
Compare diagonal properties: congruent, perpendicular, bisecting each other, and bisecting angles
Use side and angle properties to solve measure problems
Identify which properties always hold for each special parallelogram
Explain why a square has both rectangle and rhombus properties
Avoid relying only on appearance when classifying quadrilaterals
prerequisites: Identify parallelograms and their basic properties
Recognize congruent sides and congruent angles
Use angle measures such as 90 degrees
Understand that diagonals connect opposite vertices
Solve simple equations from geometric relationships
